sm_top.sm: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy ordered the resumption of strikes on Russian oil refineries following US President Trump's assertions regarding an energy strike ceasefire.
Strikes hit the airport complex and government-held areas in Aden, with the Houthis claiming responsibility.
Deadly missile attacks were reported at Riyadh airport.
Drone attacks on ships in the Black Sea left sailors missing, prompting investigations.
A missile strike hit the Saudi Aramco headquarters in Dhahran, causing a limited fire.
An oil tanker caught fire near the Strait of Hormuz following an incident.
Intensifying clashes between Houthi and Yemeni government forces in Taiz have deepened the humanitarian crisis.
Ukraine resumed attacks on Russian oil refineries.
A tanker struck a mine and caught fire in the Strait of Hormuz.
The USS Robert Smalls returns to San Diego following a 7-month deployment.
The Saudi-led coalition intercepted a missile aimed at Medina.
President Zelenskyy states that allies failed to warn Ukraine of an impending missile attack.
Russia launched a massive drone and missile attack across Ukraine, leaving 600,000 households without electricity.
The Saudi-led coalition intercepted fresh drones and missiles over Saudi Arabia and the Red Sea.
An alleged terrorist plot directed by Iran was foiled at RAF Fairford in the UK.
Attacks on ships in the Strait of Hormuz reached record levels with vessels struck and sunk.
Reports indicate the United States is weighing the potential use of the GBU-43/B Massive Ordnance Air Blast in strike plans against Iran.
Reports indicated Ukraine is critically low on Patriot interceptors as Russian strikes intensify.
A ship caught fire in the Black Sea near Romania, prompting an investigation into a possible drone strike.
A drone attack sparked a fire at an industrial facility in Russia's Surgut district.
Russian drone attacks killed three people in Ukraine and cut power to 370,000 residents in Volyn Oblast.
Ukrainian Armed Forces destroyed bombers at a Russian airfield in Borisoglebsk.
The Saudi-led coalition stated it destroyed two Houthi missile launch platforms in Yemen.
A Ukrainian drone strike disrupted operations at Russian airports and flights.
Ukraine launched a massive wave of drone strikes targeting locations in Russia, including Moscow, leading to airport suspensions.
Germany agreed to provide tens of thousands of interceptor drones to Ukraine.
Poland scrambled its air force in response to Russian air attacks against Ukraine.
Russia attacked energy infrastructure across multiple regions, leaving some residents without electricity.
Houthis launched a deadly attack on Yemen's presidential palace, resulting in casualties.
Yemeni military forces reported carrying out airstrikes and neutralizing numerous Houthi fighters.
Missiles hit Kyiv as Ukraine accused the US of helping Russia.
Russian strikes in western Ukraine caused casualties and power outages.
Suspected Boko Haram fighters attacked a military base in Borno, leaving soldiers and civilians feared dead.
Russian drone strikes in Kyiv injured people and caused damage.
Ethiopian forces advanced in Tigray and entered major cities including Aksum, Adigrat, and Adwa.
Russian air defenses shot down dozens of Ukrainian drones en route to Moscow.
Russian forces seized control of 12 new settlements in Ukraine over the past week.
Vessel attacks near the Strait of Hormuz reach a record high.
Russian airstrike hit a flea market in Kharkiv, killing 2 and injuring 19.
Drone attacks on tankers in the Black Sea left crew members missing off Romania.
